summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for embeddings-driven KB + semantic search. Starting with Hosted API POC focused on nightly batch embedding pipeline and low-latency QA search. After seeing throughput variability in hosted POC, customer is exploring a Dedicated pilot for predictable QPS and cost. Security team requires SOC2 evidence, KMS integration details, and EU residency option for a subset of data.
use_case_summary: Primary: semantic KB search for product docs + in-app support; nightly batch embedding job (~500k documents monthly), real-time incremental embeds for new docs, requirement for vector DB sync (they use managed Milvus today, considering Pinecone/Weaviate). Throughput target: 800-2,000 QPS at 90ms p50 for search path; batch embedding throughput target: embed 20-50k docs per hour during off-peak windows. Cost sensitivity: mid-market ARR, needs predictable unit economics to justify reserved capacity.
